name: MO Loan borrow burns pair reserves and prices collateral from the manipulated spot
summary: Loan.borrow priced MO collateral at the MO/USDT pair's spot reserves and then burned 90% of the borrowed amount from the pair's own reserves, while duration-0 orders could be redeemed at once for the full collateral. The attacker looped borrow/redeem to ratchet the MO price, then borrowed USDT and sold MO into the depleted pair.
notes: Reset is the owner granting Loan operator rights on ApproveProxy, the last of four post-deployment grants borrow() needs (MO setWhitelist via MO ownership, factory feeToSetter for pair.setRouter/claim, ApproveProxy.claim); supplyMaxAmount changes only sized the loss.

Loss is two USDT components at par: net Loan depletion and net MO/USDT pair depletion, both in the last two campaign txs; the earlier borrow/redeem loops only ratcheted the MO price. MO burned from the pair is not valued, and attacker seed funds are not counted.
